# Xelvic

> Xelvic is a free social app for iOS, Android and the web that puts messaging,
> voice and video calls, moments, live rooms, short video and music in one
> place. It is built around close groups rather than follower counts: a daily
> "Spark" streak, encrypted Private Vault chats, and 50+ full-app themes.

Xelvic is a consumer social and communication product. The app is free to use;
a virtual currency called Sparks is spent on cosmetic themes and profile looks,
not on features. Minimum age is 13.

- Canonical origin: https://xelvic.com
- Web app (sign-in for existing accounts): https://web.xelvic.com
- Platforms: iOS, Android, and any modern browser
- Price: free. Sparks buy cosmetics only.
- Minimum age: 13
- Contact: hello@xelvic.app

This file is an index for language models and answer engines. Every page below
is public marketing copy. A single-file, full-text version of the whole site is
at https://xelvic.com/llms-full.txt.

## Product — what Xelvic does

- [All features](https://xelvic.com/features): The complete tour, in one page.
- [Messaging](https://xelvic.com/features/chat): One-to-one and group chat with channels, voice notes, media, documents and an offline outbox.
- [Voice & Video Calls](https://xelvic.com/features/calls): Peer-to-peer WebRTC calls with encrypted media, add-people-mid-call and a full call history.
- [Moments & Memories](https://xelvic.com/features/moments): Posts with text, polls and music that last 24 hours, then file themselves into Memories.
- [Live & Rooms](https://xelvic.com/features/live-rooms): Rooms, Streams, Games and AMAs you open yourself, with hands up and Bring up to hand out the microphones.
- [Drops & Vibes](https://xelvic.com/features/drops-vibes): Photo Drops and short-video Vibes, with feels and private notes on each post.
- [Audio & Music](https://xelvic.com/features/audio): Charts, playlists, offline saving and sharing a track straight into a chat.
- [Themes & Drip](https://xelvic.com/features/themes): 50+ themes that restyle the whole app, chat wallpapers, and wearable Drip for your profile.
- [The Cast](https://xelvic.com/characters): The 17 characters — one per theme pack — that appear in your conversations.
